tools.name: get_product_context
tools.description: Read the selected product's name, site, description, ICP summary, language, Product Brain availability, and dashboard link. No provider credentials or raw unbounded configuration are returned.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: List unarchived lead lists in the selected product. Returns exact total and bounded pages. A list's cached lead count is not used for the total.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Read one unarchived list in the selected product and its exact member count. Does not return contacts; use list_list_contacts.

tools.name: list_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts in one unarchived list in the selected product. Returns exact total and bounded pages. Does not expose email or provider identifiers.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: List pending, approved, or failed scheduled actions in the selected product, optionally for one campaign. Returns one bounded page and its exact total. Completed actions are not included.

tools.name: get_scheduled_action
tools.description: Read one action in the selected product: campaign, lead, type, state, scheduled and executed timestamps. Does not return provider metadata or a message body.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List open or done lead reminders in the selected product with exact total and bounded pages. Default is open. This read does not complete a reminder.

tools.name: list_insights
tools.description: List account-scoped and selected-product-scoped open insights. Each item labels its actual scope; account insights are not product-only. Exact total and bounded pages.

tools.name: get_insight
tools.description: Read one insight and its evidence for the selected product, or an explicitly account-scoped insight. Read-only; proposed changes never run here.

tools.name: list_operator_tasks
tools.description: List durable Operator tasks in the selected product. Returns bounded pages, exact total, task status, version, and links. Read-only.

tools.name: get_operator_task
tools.description: Read one durable Operator task in the selected product with its step states, action states, safe summaries, version, and progress. Does not return executable arguments or raw provider errors.

tools.name: get_access
tools.description: Read current account access for Operator and campaign actions in the selected product. Operator requires active paid or lifetime entitlement; campaign actions also accept active beta. Feature flags are account-wide. This snapshot is not an action authorization or credit quote.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a scoped note or reminder after an explicit confirmation of the exact lead, body, and due date. One request_key can be applied only once; a changed intent with the same key fails. Over MCP: call this tool once, without confirmation_token. It runs right away and returns the result.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a scoped note or reminder after an explicit confirmation of the exact lead, body, and due date. One request_key can be applied only once; a changed intent with the same key fails. Over MCP: call this tool once, without confirmation_token. It runs right away and returns the result.

tools.name: save_preference
tools.description: Save one selected-product Operator preference after explicit approval. The value is bounded JSON data, not a system instruction. Existing keys update. No provider credentials or tokens are accepted. Over MCP: call this tool once, without confirmation_token. It runs right away and returns the result.

tools.name: rename_list
tools.description: Rename one unarchived list in the selected product after explicit approval. Supply its current name to reject stale changes; include the full new description. Over MCP: call this tool once, without confirmation_token. It runs right away and returns the result.

tools.name: control_operator_task

tools.name: get_analytics

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_apps, list_list_contacts, get_scheduled_action, get_campaign, update_campaign_settings, get_daily_priorities, get_lead, get_conversation_context, get_inbox_queue, list_operator_files, get_reply_attempt, import_search_leads_to_list, create_campaign_draft, pause_agent, create_agent · Private data: get_product_context, get_list, list_list_contacts, save_preference, list_operator_files, prepare_conversation_reply, send_conversation_reply, list_preferences, import_search_leads_to_list, enable_campaign, pause_campaign, enable_agent, pause_agent, approve_leads, update_icp · Public sink: list_list_contacts, update_campaign_settings, get_conversation_context, list_operator_files, send_conversation_reply, create_campaign_draft, draft_message · Destructive: get_insight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_apps, list_list_contacts, get_scheduled_action, get_campaign, update_campaign_settings, get_daily_priorities, get_lead, get_conversation_context, get_inbox_queue, list_operator_files, get_reply_attempt, import_search_leads_to_list, create_campaign_draft, pause_agent, create_agent · Private data: get_product_context, get_list, list_list_contacts, save_preference, list_operator_files, prepare_conversation_reply, send_conversation_reply, list_preferences, import_search_leads_to_list, enable_campaign, pause_campaign, enable_agent, pause_agent, approve_leads, update_icp · Public sink: list_list_contacts, update_campaign_settings, get_conversation_context, list_operator_files, send_conversation_reply, create_campaign_draft, draft_message · Destructive: get_insight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
